notes: 🎟️ City events. Every story now has things going on around town over the next two weeks: live shows, night markets, big sales, movie premieres, arcade tournaments, street food festivals, gallery openings, more on weekends. People who'd enjoy an event make plans to go (it goes in their schedule, so you can find them there), mention it, or ask you along. 🧰 Tools → 🎟️ City lists everything with times, places and prices; buying a ticket puts it in your plans.
